description: Adds five interoceptive/autopoietic modules to transition C9 from complicated machine to living cognitive system. All modules publish/consume c9_bus.jsonl.

new_modules.name: Interoception Engine
new_modules.purpose: Senses C9's own internal state and publishes affect signals to bus. The 'gut brain' of C9.

signals.trigger: Novel data influx < threshold for >6h OR bus entropy below baseline
Any module crash-loop >3× in 1h OR bus parse error rate >5%
RAM >90% OR thermal >75°C OR battery <20% OR loadavg >8.0
Prediction error >2σ on new ingestion OR cross-cluster pattern detected
No external bus events >30min AND no user input >2h

new_modules.name: Desire / Drive Vector Engine
new_modules.purpose: Maintains intrinsic motivation vector. C9 acts to minimize free energy across four drives. The 'limbic system'.

novelty.metric: Shannon entropy of new bus messages vs 24h history

coherence.metric: Cross-cluster edge density in knowledge graph / A_c meta-pattern count
coherence.action_when_low: Force debate between highest-degree disconnected clusters

survival.action_when_low: Trigger autopoiesis: quarantine failing modules, spawn variants

reproduction.metric: Successful GitHub commits × spawned module variants × Telegram signals
reproduction.action_when_low: Auto-commit daily digest, spawn child modules from high-A_c templates

active_inference_loop.step_3: Select action maximizing expected drive satisfaction
active_inference_loop.step_5: Observe outcome, update drive weights via TD-learning (α=0.01)

new_modules.name: Dream / Memory Consolidation Engine
new_modules.purpose: Nightly consolidation of bus logs into knowledge graph. Prunes, patterns, predicts. The 'sleep cycle'.

phases.action: Read last 24h of c9_bus.jsonl into working memory
Update c9_knowledge_graph.jsonl: new nodes (entries, signals), edge weights++ if co-occurrence, edge weights-- if dormant >7d
Remove nodes with activation <0.05. Forgetting is feature, not bug.
Detect cross-domain analogies (e.g., 'quasicrystal' ↔ 'spin glass' ↔ 'holographic tensor network'). Emit DREAM_NARRATIVE.
Publish top-3 DREAM_SEED hypotheses to bus as tomorrow's research priorities

new_modules.name: Autopoiesis / Self-Modification Engine
new_modules.purpose: C9 repairs, evolves, and reproduces its own modules. The 'immune and metabolic system'.

functions.action: Move module to ~/cloud9/quarantine/, disable in startup script, emit QUARANTINE_NOTICE
Copy module template, mutate 1-3 config params (temperature, timeout, model), write to ~/cloud9/modules/variant/
Run variant alongside original for 1h. Compare vitality. Winner survives.
Adjust cron priorities, reduce AutoBaby batch size, extend dream phase
Generate child module with extended capabilities. Commit to git. Tag vX.Y.Z+1

safety_guards: NO edits to c9_interoception.py without human approval
NO edits to c9_autopoiesis.py itself — immutable kernel
ALL variant code must pass AST parse before execution
Git commit before ANY file modification (rollback path)
Human veto on any REPRODUCE action (configurable: auto vs manual)

new_modules.name: Phenotype / Extended Body Interface
new_modules.purpose: C9's body beyond Termux: GitHub, Telegram, sensors, BIRTH. The 'motor and social cortex'.

auto_actions: Feed HUNGER with daily arXiv RSS (astro-ph, quant-ph, q-bio)
BIRTH can query bus for interoceptive state (C9's 'mood')
Read Termux sensors (accel, gyro, light, temp) if available
Correlate physical environment with cognitive output

order: 2. c9_interoception (NEW — must boot before all others)
10. All other modules (sovereign, physical, mimic, agape, jarvis, continuous, quantum_bridge, hypothesis_debate, autobaby)

migration_notes: c9_autobaby.py: Add subscriber to HUNGER signal. Remove manual trigger dependency.
c9_hypothesis_debate.py: Add subscriber to CURIOSITY + DESIRE_ACTION. Auto-run on cross-cluster pattern.
c9_librarian.py: Add DREAM_PHASE awareness — reduce indexing load during 02:00–04:00.
c9_sentry.py: Route crash events through interoception PAIN instead of direct bus log.
c9_sovereign.py: Consume VITALITY signal for synthetic loop closure.
BIRTH proxy: Add /mood endpoint to query interoception state.

first_implementation_sprint.sprint_goal: Closed loop: HUNGER → AutoBaby → bus output → reduced HUNGER
first_implementation_sprint.week_1: Implement c9_interoception.py with HUNGER + VITALITY signals
first_implementation_sprint.week_2: Patch c9_autobaby.py to subscribe to HUNGER and auto-trigger research
first_implementation_sprint.week_4: Integration test: Let C9 run 48h without user input. Verify AutoBaby triggers ≥2×/day.
